title: MS-COOT: Comparing Morse-Smale Complexes with Co-Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2606.08258v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Understanding and comparing structures in scalar fields is a central challenge in scientific visualization, with applications ranging from feature analysis to temporal and structural comparison. The Morse-Smale (MS) complex provides a natural representation by decomposing a scalar field into regions induced by gradient flow. However, existing approaches typically rely on graph-based representations, matching critical points without explicitly establishing correspondences between regions. In this work, we represent the MS complex as a hypergraph, where critical points form nodes and regions define hyperedges. We introduce MS-COOT, a co-optimal transport distance that jointly computes correspondences between critical points and regions. translated_title: MS-COOT：基于共最优传输的Morse-Smale复形比较
translated_abstract: 理解与比较标量场中的结构是科学可视化中的一项核心挑战，其应用涵盖从特征分析到时间与结构比较等多个方面。Morse-Smale（MS）复形通过将标量场分解为由梯度流诱导的区域，提供了一种自然的表示方式。然而，现有方法通常依赖基于图的表示，仅匹配临界点，而未显式建立区域之间的对应关系。在本工作中，我们将MS复形表示为超图，其中临界点构成节点，区域定义超边。我们提出了MS-COOT，一种共最优传输距离，可联合计算临界点与区域之间的对应关系。这一公式化方法使得在基于距离的框架内能够进行显式的区域到区域匹配，从而可以识别区域级别的事件，例如分裂与合并。我们实例化了这一框架……
tldr: 提出MS-COOT方法，将Morse-Smale复形表示为超图并利用共最优传输距离联合计算临界点与区域的对应关系，实现了显式的区域到区域匹配，从而能够识别分裂、合并等区域级事件。
en_tdlr: MS-COOT introduces a co-optimal transport distance that represents Morse-Smale complexes as hypergraphs and jointly computes correspondences between critical points and regions, enabling explicit region-to-region matching to identify region-level events such as splitting and merging.
